---
title: "The Problem"
subtitle: "A hidden failure mode in every fine-tuned model"
---

## The Core Problem

- Companies spend significant resources fine-tuning LLMs for domain tasks — and **have no way to know** if the model learned real reasoning or just memorized surface patterns
- The result: models that ace internal benchmarks, then **fail silently** on real customer inputs — 20–40pp accuracy drops are routine
- This is not a research curiosity — it is a **deployment blocker** in any domain where errors have consequences
- **No production tooling exists** to detect or fix this during training

## Why Now

```{dot}
//| label: fig-why-now
//| fig-cap: "Four converging forces create urgency"
//| fig-width: 6
//| fig-height: 3.5
digraph G {
  bgcolor="transparent"
  rankdir=TB
  graph [ranksep=0.4, nodesep=0.5]
  node [style=filled, fillcolor="#2c3035", color="#4a9eda",
        fontcolor="#f8f9fa", fontname="Arial", fontsize=10,
        shape=box, width=2.0, height=0.5, margin="0.12,0.08"]
  edge [style=invis]

  A [label="Regulated Domains\nAdopting LLMs", fillcolor="#375a7f", color="#f0ad4e"]
  B [label="Fine-Tuning\nAmplifies Shortcuts", fillcolor="#375a7f", color="#f0ad4e"]

  C [label="No Production\nTooling Exists", fillcolor="#4a2040", color="#e74c3c"]
  D [label="EU AI Act / FDA\nMandate Robustness", fillcolor="#375a7f", color="#f0ad4e"]

  { rank=same; A; B }
  { rank=same; C; D }

  A -> C
  B -> D
}
```

- **Regulated domains adopting LLMs** — finance, healthcare, legal now require robustness evidence
- **Fine-tuning amplifies shortcuts** — smaller domain corpora are more pattern-rich
- **No production tooling exists** — current mitigations are expensive, ad hoc, incomplete
- **Regulatory pressure is real** — EU AI Act and FDA AI/ML guidance mandate demonstrable robustness

## Where This Hurts Most

```{dot}
//| label: fig-domains
//| fig-cap: "Every regulated domain faces the same failure pattern"
//| fig-width: 6
//| fig-height: 3.5
digraph G {
  bgcolor="transparent"
  rankdir=TB
  graph [ranksep=0.4, nodesep=0.5]
  node [style=filled, fillcolor="#2c3035", color="#4a9eda",
        fontcolor="#f8f9fa", fontname="Arial", fontsize=10,
        shape=box, width=1.8, height=0.5, margin="0.12,0.08"]
  edge [style=invis]

  A [label="Finance\nWrong credit decisions", fillcolor="#4a2040", color="#e74c3c"]
  B [label="Medical\nFails novel cases", fillcolor="#4a2040", color="#e74c3c"]

  C [label="Legal\nMisapplied precedent", fillcolor="#4a2040", color="#e74c3c"]
  D [label="Adversarial\nSystematic evasion", fillcolor="#4a2040", color="#e74c3c"]

  { rank=same; A; B }
  { rank=same; C; D }

  A -> C
  B -> D
}
```

| Domain | Shortcut Failure Mode | Business Consequence |
|--------|----------------------|---------------------|
| **Finance** | Keys on revenue alone, ignores margin + debt | Wrong credit decisions; regulatory exposure |
| **Medical** | Memorizes symptom-diagnosis co-occurrence | Fails on novel presentations; patient safety risk |
| **Legal** | Pattern-matches jurisdiction keywords | Misapplies precedent; liability |
| **Adversarial** | Surface patterns exploited by adversaries | Systematic evasion of model checks |

::: {.callout-important}
**Trust is the bottleneck, not capability.** Buyers need proof that models reason correctly — not just that they score well.
:::
